uiConfig.name: Service Principal
uiConfig.description: Authenticate Microsoft Fabric SQL and OneLake access with a Microsoft Entra service principal

fields.label: Tenant ID
fields.note: Enter the directory (tenant) ID for the Microsoft Entra service principal. Enable the Fabric tenant setting that allows service principals to use Fabric APIs.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.note: Enter the application (client) ID for the Microsoft Entra service principal. Grant it Contributor or higher on both the Lakehouse and Warehouse workspaces.

fields.label: Client Secret
fields.placeholder: Enter the service principal client secret
fields.note: Enter the client secret value for the Microsoft Entra application.
